about.title: About me
text: I'm a software developer. I founded useblocks and, as team lead, built Sphinx-Needs and a number of other docs-as-code tools that run in large engineering projects today. Today I support useblocks as an advisor.
What drives me is how large, distributed teams keep track: of requirements, tests, decisions and the knowledge in between. My tools are small, honest and solve one problem properly.
